project.title: Modular Berlin city-map wall panel

process.printer: Anycubic FDM printer with at least 220 x 220 mm XY build area and four-filament single-nozzle system

coordinate_frame.origin: lower-left corner of the assembled art-tile rear datum plane
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X right in the installed front view
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y upward in the installed front view
coordinate_frame.z_axis: +Z from the wall toward the viewer
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps component source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The 600 x 400 mm artwork shall consist of six individually printable 200 mm-pitch tiles on a segmented rear grid.
requirements.verification: global-frame bounds, bed-fit checks, assembled seam report and physical 3 x 2 alignment test

requirements.statement: One immutable Berlin vector master shall own map position and cross-seam feature continuity; tiles shall never be scaled or normalized independently.
requirements.verification: source hash, global clipping audit and matched seam-coordinate report

requirements.statement: The artwork shall use no more than four broad explicit color regions in the approved Urban Signal palette without dithering.
requirements.source: approved concept v01 and palette catalog 0.2.0
requirements.verification: named color-body audit, portable 3MF validation and exact-slicer tool/change/purge report

requirements.statement: The printed product shall work unlit while reserving an 18 mm halo cavity, generic LED routes and protected true through-openings for customer-added lighting.
requirements.source: approved design specification and concept v01
requirements.verification: keep-out collision checks, aperture geometry report, light gauge and physical illuminated coupon

requirements.statement: Each art tile shall be replaceable without disturbing the wall-mounted rear grid and shall survive 25 removal/reinstall cycles in the declared test.
requirements.verification: interface coupon followed by repeated tile service-cycle test

requirements.statement: LEDs, electrical parts and wall anchors are excluded and no structural wall-anchor compatibility or electrical-safety claim shall be made.
requirements.verification: BOM, instructions, risk register and release-package review

global_style.summary: Abstract architectural Berlin map with restrained relief, crisp color solids and sparse luminous paths
exclude: LED components in the sold print set
global_style.generation_material: matte Anycubic PLA palette with a neutral PETG rear grid
global_style.detail_hierarchy: whole-panel composition first, seam-continuous primary routes second, broad fields third, printable minor routes last

assembly_sequence: Join and square the six REAR_GRID segments in the global 3 x 2 frame.
Install customer-selected wall anchors through the documented generic mounting slots after substrate-specific review.
Optionally install customer lighting into the halo and front-light envelopes, route the cable through one selected exit and add diffuser film if desired.
Place each ART_TILE_SET member on its gravity shoulder and datum pads; retention hardware supplies only normal holding force.
Verify 0.25 mm target seams, cross-seam map continuity, tile retention and unobstructed intended light openings.

decision_log.topic: Approve this component, interface and manufacturing decomposition.
decision_log.current_basis: Concept v01 is approved; the guided autonomy policy assigns decomposition approval to the human owner.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Explicit approval of plan/hybrid-design-plan.json or requested corrections.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the exact magnetic tile-retention hardware and pocket compensation.
decision_log.current_basis: Recommended architecture uses gravity shoulders and three datum pads for load/alignment plus four captive 6 x 2 mm magnets and steel counterparts per tile for normal retention.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact magnet/steel part records, pull-off target, same-process pocket coupon and captive-retention test.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the Berlin OpenStreetMap extraction extent, timestamp, hashes and attribution treatment.
decision_log.current_basis: Official OpenStreetMap data is the approved route, but production source download starts after decomposition approval.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable local vector snapshot, extraction manifest, hashes and reviewed ODbL notice.

decision_log.topic: Freeze actual Urban Signal filament spools and transition purge matrix.
decision_log.current_basis: Retail Anycubic PLA Matte names and display colors are selected; batch identity and measured swatches are not yet available.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Spool/batch identities, physical swatches, opacity notes and exact-profile transition coupon.

decision_log.topic: Select wall-substrate-specific anchors outside the product package.
decision_log.current_basis: The printed grid will expose generic mounting slots but cannot determine the customer's wall substrate.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Actual wall substrate, chosen anchor data and installed proof test by the responsible installer.
